ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent IoT diagnostic platform running locally to monitor mechanical vibration anomalies for industrial hardware labs.
ideas.title: SmartEdge Asset Diagnostic Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical IoT sensor simulation with a multi-agent diagnostic loop, directly mirroring successful autonomous ops architectures that impress engineering juries.

ideas.pitch: A local AI assistant leveraging hardware acceleration for low-latency code auto-completion and inline bug fixing during live prototyping.
ideas.title: NPU-Accelerated Code Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leans heavily into edge/local computing performance which stands out in a technical prototyping competition with dedicated laboratory venues like CAR and Garuda Labs.

ideas.pitch: An interactive data-profiling tool performing automated exploratory data analysis, schema validation, and integrity scoring with natural language querying.
ideas.title: AutoEDA & Integrity Data Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, tedious workflow bottleneck for data engineers and researchers with a fully working, demonstrable dashboard rather than vaporware.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that classifies incoming queries using vector embeddings to dynamically direct prompts to the most cost-effective and accurate model.
ideas.title: Dynamic LLM Gateway Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases algorithmic efficiency and architectural elegance, which technical university juries value highly over simple wrapper applications.

ideas.pitch: An embedded computer vision navigation pipeline enabling a physical robot to map coordinates and dodge dynamic obstacles locally without cloud dependency.
ideas.title: JetBot Local Perception and Navigation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings physical hardware and robotics into a venue featuring dedicated engineering labs, instantly capturing the jury's attention through a live, moving demo.
